description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the infrared face liveness detection operation DetectInfraredLivingFace
description_zh: 本文为您介绍红外人脸活体检测DetectInfraredLivingFace的语法及示例
name: DetectInfraredLivingFace

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure (image table). A maximum of 10 elements are supported, meaning up to 10 images can be detected simultaneously. We recommend using OSS links in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

The system automatically converts OSS link addresses to internal network addresses before downloading files, so calling this API does not incur OSS traffic charges
fields.help_zh:
待检测的图像URL地址。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个图片检测任务结构体（image表）。最多支持10个元素，即同时最多对10张图片进行检测。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

对于该接口，系统会自动将OSS链接地址转成内网地址然后再下载文件，所以调用该接口并不会产生OSS流量计费
fields.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The array of image URLs to be detected
parameters.help_zh: 待检测的图像URL地址数组
parameters.name: tasks

FaceNumber.description_en: The number of faces detected in a single image. If no face is detected, FaceNumber returns 0
FaceNumber.description_zh: 单张图片检测到的人脸数量。如果没有检测到人脸，FaceNumber返回为0

ImageURL.description_en: The image URL corresponding to the request
ImageURL.description_zh: 对应请求中的图像URL地址

Results.description_en: The face coordinates and liveness results
Results.description_zh: 返回人脸坐标和活体结果

Label.description_en:
The classification of the detection result. Valid values:
normal: A live photo.
liveness: A recaptured photo.

If no face is detected, Label returns liveness
Label.description_zh:
检测结果的分类，取值包括：
normal：活体照片
liveness：翻拍照片

如果没有检测到人脸，则Label返回为liveness

MessageTips.description_en:
The prompt information in plain text.

`blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.`: The input face is blurry, occluded, or at a large angle.
`no face detected, try again please.`: No face is detected
MessageTips.description_zh:
提示信息，纯文字描述。

`blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.`：如输入模糊、遮挡或大角度等的人脸。
`no face detected, try again please.`：如没有检测到人脸
MessageTips.example: blurred, occluded or large angle face, please check.

Rate.description_en:
The probability of the result belonging to this classification. Value range: [0.00-100.00]. A larger value indicates a higher probability of belonging to this classification.
If no face is detected, Rate returns 100
Rate.description_zh:
结果为该分类的概率，取值范围为[0.00-100.00]。取值越大表示属于该分类的概率越大。
如果未检测到人脸，则Rate返回为100

Rect.description_en: The face detection bounding box information. If no face is detected, all Rect face detection coordinates return 0
Rect.description_zh: 人脸检测框信息。如果未检测到人脸，则Rect人脸检测坐标返回全为0

Height.description_en: The height of the detection bounding box

Left.description_en: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the detection bounding box
Left.description_zh: 检测框左上角的点x坐标

Top.description_en: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the detection bounding box
Top.description_zh: 检测框左上角的点y坐标

Width.description_en: The width of the detection bounding box

Suggestion.description_en:
The recommended action to execute. Valid values:

pass: The live object in the image is from a direct capture. No further action is required.
review: The live object in the image may be an attack sample. Confirm before proceeding.
block: The live object in the image is highly likely an attack sample. Execute the what to do next.

If no face is detected, Suggestion returns block
Suggestion.description_zh:
建议您执行的操作，取值范围如下：

pass：图片中的活体对象来自直接拍摄，无需进行其余操作。
review：图片中的活体对象可能为攻击样本，建议您确认后再进行操作。
block：图片中的活体对象大概率为攻击样本，建议您执行后续操作。

如果未检测到人脸，则Suggestion返回为block
